visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wearing a white t-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor apartment with neutral beige walls. He looks directly at the camera with a slight smile. On-screen graphic overlays of the Japanese and Taiwanese flags are positioned at chest level. (2) The scene transitions as the man gestures and his facial expressions change rapidly from thoughtful to a squinted-eye smile. A text overlay '食物' appears. A collage of Japanese food illustrations like sushi, tempura, and ramen appears as he crosses his arms. (3) The man touches his chin in a thinking pose as the category shifts to '氣候'. A sun icon with rays and sparkles appears. He points toward the Taiwan flag. (4) The text '時尚' appears. The man shrugs and then points toward the Taiwan flag again while two cartoon illustrations of women in stylish outfits appear on the right side. (4) [Slogan]: 氣候. [Subtitle]: 絕對是台灣!. [Subtitle]: 喔～為什麼?. (5) [Subtitle]: 我覺得只要有夏天就夠了. [Subtitle]: 日本現在就算是春天. [Subtitle]: 花粉也很誇張. (6) [Subtitle]: 四、五月我都不太想回去. (7) [Slogan]: 時尚. [Subtitle]: 這個有點困難談. (8) [Subtitle]: 但如果講到生活舒適度的話. [Subtitle]: 應該是台灣. [Subtitle]: 而且女生們. [Subtitle]: 穿搭也很好看. (9) [Subtitle]: 就是說比較性感一點啦. (10) [Slogan]: 街景. [Subtitle]: 抱歉這個我一定要說. [Subtitle]: 日本. [Subtitle]: 而且是東京. (11) [Subtitle]: 果然我真的覺得東京很美. [Subtitle]: 而且日本人也比較愛乾淨. (12) [Subtitle]: 當然台灣那種生活感的風景. [Subtitle]: 也很有味道啦. (13) [Subtitle]: 只是那種蟑螂咻咻爬過的畫面. [Subtitle]: 我還真的無法跟他當朋友誒. (14) [Slogan]: 飲品.
